contracts.asserts: Actual private arithmetic header: integer sqrt/radial response, clamp/inversion, signed fractions, extreme coordinates and saturation; all existing cases retained

Complete actual driver with Zephyr stand-ins and actual state layouts: independent origins/remainders/contact/repeat pairs, backpressure/cancellation, unchanged source button edges/sync, and X/Y boot-center sentinel rejection with valid signed neighbors
Actual DTS X/Y unset-center configurations fail for their named compile assertion; adjacent signed center limits compile on both supported cores

kernel_contracts.asserts: Actual ZMK device API/layer dispatcher and input-queue repeat pairs: invalid index, two independent streams, transparent touch/button sync, one pair in flight with controlled acknowledgements, touch/layer cancellation of overdue work

limits: Native checks include real input-queue repeat pairs with controlled acknowledgements and overdue work cancellation; this is not actual HID/radio congestion acceptance.

execution.default: quick: every behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same scenarios plus optimized, coverage and existing 32-bit variants
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

fixtures.asserts: Actual full runtime entry rejects empty, unrelated and partial measurement; direct controls reject absent/zero functions and missed lines/branches; separate arithmetic and complete driver coverage gates
Supported clean pins, safe layout/output and pinned custom-settings archive/digest admission with bypass controls; DYA selects this dependency
Existing directories, directory symlinks and dangling symlinks preserve prior evidence and invoke no west command

infrastructure.preparation: Explicit pinned offline workspace; local unchanged ZMK clone and original fixture manifest; no fetch or source repair
infrastructure.limits: Admission tests control dependency responses. Actual native/API/firmware fixtures separately verify unchanged stock ZMK and DYA. Physical transport remains separate.

suppression_extraction: Source KEY payload/sync stays unchanged; independent final filter owns button disposition and filtered-frame completion. Current ownership map: tests/README.md.
runtime_settings: Whole-source adapter and driver fixtures; real API/overdue-work cancellation, DYA registry and three NVS reboot pairs; tests/README.md
scheduled_work_settings_review: The bounded host FIFO and actual native input queue now force X admission / Y refusal. They verify retry-only-Y, no duplicate X, ordered completion and recovery across touch/layer/settings cancellation. The complete driver also tests synchronous callback reentry on either axis. X refusal now attempts no Y, so the existing failure case expects one warning/API attempt instead of two; all value/order and recovery assertions remain. The native fixture deliberately uses an eight-slot queue; this is API/kernel evidence, not physical HID congestion acceptance.
selected_workspace: Workspace selection uses tests/integration/workspace-env.sh to export the selected manifest's ZEPHYR_MODULES and explicit Zephyr package/base paths. A Zephyr symlink to a different cache must not select that cache's module providers. The owner test_workspace_env.py exercises actual selection with a poisoned ambient list, a cache symlink, module paths containing spaces, failed project discovery and an empty selection. The keep-ambient negative control must fail these assertions. Full integration retains all supported-core, role, persistence and invalid-DTS cases. No dependency is patched or required feature disabled.

integer_width.production: 32-bit arithmetic; independent wider oracles remain test-only
integer_width.contract: Coordinate offsets use checked 32-bit subtraction. Radial output distribution divides into whole and fractional parts before multiplication, preserving the existing bounds, signed remainder and report rounding without wide arithmetic.
integer_width.fixtures: runtime/math_harness.c retains radial direction/ramp, full-coordinate extremes, fractions, inversion and saturation. The whole-driver fixtures remain unchanged.

arithmetic_fast_paths.contract: The repeat worker calculates the radial distance once for its stored X/Y pair, then applies each axis's own deadzone, gain, limit, inversion and fraction. Live ABS events still use their most recent partner coordinate independently. tests/test_repeat_cost.py compiles the complete driver fixture with compiler function-entry instrumentation at O0/O2: exact asymmetric/reversed/zero/saturated pairs, stream selection, sync and one square-root entry per repeat. The old worker fails the count assertion. The canonical host entry includes it; this is an operation count, not a CPU-cycle or physical timing measurement.

repeat_regressions.contract: Quiet fractional progress; deadzone/zero-gain stop; fully queued ownership across reset, source isolation, route-independent raw-Y acknowledgement and no late double acknowledgement
repeat_regressions.negative: Unmodified prior driver must fail both named behavioral assertions
repeat_regressions.limits: Real queues/API plus controlled callbacks; no physical HID/sensor acceptance

source_allocation_bound.contract: Automatic0 preserves one slot per enabled global listener (minimum1); positive1..256 is an exclusive original-source-index bound per node, no remapping. Exact upstream device-status gate and base/all-child routes reject referenced sparse overflow at compile time. NULL/invalid-runtime behavior and admitted independent source state remain.
source_allocation_bound.host: tests/test_source_limits.py: actual full driver ASan+UBSan; full adds O2/m32; automatic2/5, bound2/256/1, no-listener fallback, highest index, NULL and invalid unchanged event/state
source_allocation_bound.dts: tests/integration/source-limits.py:42 actual Zephyr-generator compile cases per core with named range/sparse/base/child/disabled-child rejections, device/listener status semantics and skip-routes/skip-children controls
source_allocation_bound.kernel: Both full integration entries retain all native/registry/NVS cases and run automatic5 and limited2 binaries three times each at actual source IDs0/1. An additional original-order automatic5 profile retains actual IDs3/4, every original assertion and actual input-listener callbacks; its generated header must reject bound2 by the named guard. All mouse behaviors remain enabled.
source_allocation_bound.limits: No physical HID/timing/power/live stack-high-water acceptance; linked slot sizes and compiler frames are static evidence.
